page.layout: One page: a title page. Printed lines run down the centre, with a printer's device or ornament in the middle. A library stamp sits in the upper centre and is left out.
page.notes: The page is very faint. Most of the printed title is barely visible through the paper and cannot be read letter by letter. The line near the bottom reads roughly "M. DC. VIII", but the numerals are uncertain. The large dark stain at the top edge and the round library stamp "BIBLIOTHECA REGIA MONACENSIS" are not printed text and are left out. The central ornament or printer's device is not text and is not transcribed. Mirrored show-through from the other side of the leaf may account for some of the faint marks and is not transcribed.
